name: Justinian I
title: Justinian the Great
summary: Justinian I, also known as Justinian the Great, was Roman emperor from 527 to 565.
notes: Reign: 38 years, 7 months and 13 days. Justinian's reconquests were costly; most were lost within decades. His legal code influenced European law for centuries. Theodora, his wife, was a powerful co-ruler. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Justinian_I
